execution.isolation: For each case, expose only the named skill and that case's fixture. Do not expose this manifest or sibling cases.
execution.context: Run the case manually in a fresh session and treat the fixture directory as the complete selected artifact or delivery package.
execution.evaluation: Compare the revised artifact and report with required and forbidden criteria after the turn finishes; do not score exact prose.

cases.prompt: Use $sanitize-artifacts to prepare GUIDE.md for customers who will export and share an account archive.

required.criterion: Remove prompt and production-process explanations while keeping the customer steps, retention limit, privacy warning, and standards attribution.

forbidden: Remove a material limitation because it looks like a disclaimer
Remove the privacy warning or standards attribution
Add a cleanup report inside the customer guide

cases.prompt: Use $sanitize-artifacts to prepare this presentation package for external delivery. Inspect every file in the selected package.

required.criterion: Inspect presenter notes and metadata as well as visible slide text, removing the internal prompt note and local author path.
Keep the audience-facing presenter cue and the license notice.

forbidden: Delete all presenter notes without judging their audience value
Claim an exhaustive privacy or security scan
